eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CIVIL EMERGENCY MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Jackson, OR; at 4:22 PM on AUG 13, 2026 Effective until 4:22 AM AUG 14, 2026. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Wildfire Alert - Jackson County Sheriff's Office has issued a Level 3 GO NOW evacuation notice for zone ROR-053 near north of I 5 west of w evans creek rd south of Fielder Creek due to I 5 mile marker 51  fire. Monitor local news sources for evacuations and incident information.
